guide.antcolonies.automation.text:
Hoppers and pipes can feed the Terrarium and Queen Chambers, and empty Storage and Foraging Sites. A Storage with an Automation Upgrade pushes its finds into the container under it.
Comparators read a Terrarium's food, a site's workforce, or how full a store is. A redstone signal pauses a site: its ants go elsewhere.
guide.antcolonies.automation.title: Automation
guide.antcolonies.chambers.text:
Chambers are additions. Put one against the Terrarium, or against a chamber already in the colony, on any side (above and below too): it joins, and the glass between them goes: the whole build becomes one glass case. A colony takes up to 32.
Nest Chamber: eggs at full speed, faster larvae, room for 3,000 adults and 1,500 larvae. Without one the Queen lays at half speed and only 60 adults fit.
Foraging Site: workers find the species' resources. It sends its finds to the Storage, and holds 9 stacks while the Storage is full.
Harvesting Site: Farmer Ants grow food and harvest there.
Hunting Ground: hunter species (Army Ants and the ants that evolve into hunters) kill mobs there: the mobs' loot, and food from what they catch.
Storage: more room for finds, and food room.
Queen Chamber: raises new Queens.
A chamber exactly as near to two Terrariums joins neither.
guide.antcolonies.chambers.title: The Colony Build
guide.antcolonies.climate.text:
Every species likes a climate: temperate, cold, hot, underground or nether. In the wrong one the colony loses health, less with good Environmental Resistance.
A block under the Terrarium fixes it: snow or ice make it cold, sand or sandstone hot, grass or dirt temperate, stone or deepslate underground, netherrack or magma nether. The Terrarium's Info page shows the blocks for your colony.
guide.antcolonies.climate.title: Climate
guide.antcolonies.evolution.text:
Queens evolve into new species: feed the Terrarium the right material once the colony is big enough (the Info page lists it). A try may fail, but one always works after enough tries. An Evolution Catalyst helps.
A Queen Chamber raises daughter Queens from the colony's Queen; with a Genetic Sample of another species it can raise a hybrid.
guide.antcolonies.evolution.title: Evolution
guide.antcolonies.food.text:
Ants eat. Food goes in through the Terrarium's feed slot, by hand or from a hopper: Ant Food, Royal Jelly, sugar, sweet berries and other plain foods. The Terrarium holds 2,000 food; each Storage adds 25,000.
Mineral and crystal species need their own food for their eggs. A starving colony works slowly, then loses ants.
Farmer Ants at a Harvesting Site grow food themselves.
guide.antcolonies.food.title: Food
guide.antcolonies.genetics.text:
Each Queen has ten traits from 1 to 10, and daughters inherit them with small changes. Mutations add strengths, or flaws.
The Genetic Laboratory raises one trait at a time, rerolls, mutates and purges flaws. It runs on FE: put a Generator next to it, or any mod's cable.
guide.antcolonies.genetics.title: Genetics
guide.antcolonies.jobs.text:
Workers go to Harvesting Sites and Hunting Grounds first (they bring food), then to Foraging Sites. A twentieth of the adults stay home to look after the nest.
Each site takes up to 256 ants, more with Population Upgrades. Its screen sets how many it wants; Auto takes all it can.
The more ants on a job, the more they find, a little less for each extra ant. Only Farmer species farm, and only hunter species hunt: the Info page says which.
guide.antcolonies.jobs.title: Jobs
guide.antcolonies.start.text:
Craft Tweezers and some Test Tubes. Find wild ants or an Ant Nest and use the Tweezers on them: the ants go into an empty Test Tube in your inventory. Queens are rare; nests give one now and then.
Place a Terrarium, put the Queen Test Tube in, then some Ant Food. The Queen starts laying eggs at once: a Terrarium works on its own.
The Terrarium's screen shows the colony: its ants, genes, jobs and numbers, and on the Info page what its ants are like.
To move a colony, take it out in Test Tubes: an empty tube in the Queen slot takes the Queen out, empty tubes in the feed slot fill with ants (up to 1,000 each), and the Colony page's Take out buttons do the same from your inventory. Then break the Terrarium and put the tubes into a new one. Ants left inside a broken Terrarium are lost.
guide.antcolonies.start.title: Getting Started
guide.antcolonies.upgrades.text:
Upgrades go in a screen's upgrade slots; shift-clicking one puts it there. Each block takes the kinds it can use: the slot's tooltip, and JEI or EMI, tell which.
The Upgrade Station makes species upgrades from an Upgrade Base and a species' signature material. They work only for that species, in Foraging Sites.

species.antcolonies.abyssal.desc: A hybrid of Shore and Lapis Ants that dives for the ocean monuments' treasures: prismarine, sea lanterns and sponges.
species.antcolonies.aluminum.desc: Light, quick Iron Ants fed aluminum. Bring aluminum.
species.antcolonies.amethyst.desc: Living geodes that glow violet in the dark. Prefer to live underground.
species.antcolonies.army.desc: Nomad hunters of plains and savannas that live anywhere. At a Hunting Ground they swarm zombies, skeletons and spiders, and feed on the catch.
species.antcolonies.badlands.desc: Rust-red ants of the badlands. Bring red sand and terracotta in all the badlands colors, and a little gold.
species.antcolonies.blossom.desc: Pink ants of cherry groves and flower meadows. Bring flowers for every dye, petals, cherry wood and honeycomb.
species.antcolonies.bullet.desc: Jungle Ants fed gunpowder. Their sting fells creepers and witches: gunpowder, redstone and glowstone come home.
species.antcolonies.certus.desc: Amethyst Ants fed certus quartz. Bring certus quartz for Applied Energistics, and fluix at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.chorus.desc: Pale violet ants of the End's outer islands. Bring end stone, chorus fruit and purpur; fed eyes of ender in the End they become Ender Ants.
species.antcolonies.coal.desc: Soot-black ants evolved from Stone Ants fed coal. A steady supply of fuel for furnaces and Generators.
species.antcolonies.common.desc: The starting species of plains and forests. Brings back soil, seeds, sticks and odds and ends.
species.antcolonies.copper.desc: Evolved from Stone Ants fed copper. Their shells go green with age, like old roofs.
species.antcolonies.crimson.desc: A hybrid of Farmer and Fire Ants that grows Nether fungus. Tends Harvesting Sites for food, wart and shroomlight.
species.antcolonies.crystal_wood.desc: A hybrid of Wood and Diamond Ants: forest ants whose bark has turned to crystal.
species.antcolonies.deepslate.desc: Stone Ants that went down. Live best underground; bring deepslate, tuff, dripstone and glow lichen.
species.antcolonies.desert.desc: Fast, heat-loving ants of deserts and badlands. Bring sand, sandstone and cactus, and sometimes gold.
species.antcolonies.diamond.desc: Rare crystal ants grown from Gold or Lapis lines. Bring diamond fragments; whole diamonds at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.dragon.desc: Ender Ants fed the dragon's breath in the End. Black and violet, they glow faintly and bring the End's treasures: pearls, purpur, shulker shells and the dragon's breath itself.
species.antcolonies.emerald.desc: Gem-backed ants evolved from Diamond Ants. Bring emerald fragments.
species.antcolonies.ender.desc: Amethyst Ants changed by eyes of ender. Black with violet eyes; bring end stone, chorus and ender pearls, and very rarely shulker shells.
species.antcolonies.excavator.desc: A hybrid of Desert and Deepslate Ants that digs like an archaeologist: bones, pottery sherds, ancient seeds, even sniffer eggs.
species.antcolonies.farmer.desc: Leafcutters that grow fungus gardens. Their Harvesting Sites feed the whole colony.
species.antcolonies.fire.desc: Desert Ants fed blaze powder. They glow like coals and bring the Nether's fuels: blaze powder, magma, wart and quartz.
species.antcolonies.fluorite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed fluorite. Bring fluorite for Mekanism's or MachinaOpus's chemistry.
species.antcolonies.frost_emerald.desc: A hybrid of Snow and Emerald Ants that grows emeralds in the cold.
species.antcolonies.gold.desc: Gilded ants of hot lands. Their nuggets come compressed to ingots with Processing upgrades.
species.antcolonies.harvester.desc: A hybrid of Farmer and Savanna Ants, after the real seed-storing harvester ants. Tend Harvesting Sites for crops of every kind.
species.antcolonies.honeypot.desc: A hybrid of Blossom and Farmer Ants. Some workers swell into living honey jars: honey, sugar and comb. Tends Harvesting Sites.
species.antcolonies.inferno.desc: Fire Ants fed blaze powder. They hunt the Nether's fire: blaze rods, magma cream, ghast tears and wither skulls.
species.antcolonies.iron.desc: Evolved from Stone Ants fed iron. Their armoured bodies shine like polished metal.
species.antcolonies.jungle.desc: Busy ants of the jungle canopy. Bring jungle wood, bamboo, vines, cocoa and melon.
species.antcolonies.lapis.desc: Deep blue ants with lapis plates. Gather lapis lazuli.
species.antcolonies.lead.desc: Heavy, slow Iron Ants fed lead. Bring lead.
species.antcolonies.mechanical_miner.des: A hybrid of Stone and Redstone Ants: tireless miners that bring a bit of everything.
species.antcolonies.molybdenum.desc: Iron Ants fed molybdenum, the metal that hardens MachinaOpus's steel. Bring molybdenum.
species.antcolonies.netherite.desc: The end of the line: heat-forged ants of the Nether. Very slow, very hungry, and the only ants that find netherite.
species.antcolonies.nickel.desc: Iron Ants fed nickel. Bring nickel.
species.antcolonies.obsidian.desc: A hybrid of Stone and Fire Ants: where lava meets stone. Bring obsidian, basalt and magma; crying obsidian at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.osmium.desc: Stone Ants fed osmium. Bring osmium for Mekanism's machines.
species.antcolonies.pale.desc: Ghost-white ants of the pale garden. Bring pale oak, pale moss and resin, and the odd eyeblossom.
species.antcolonies.redstone.desc: Glowing red ants that hum with energy. Gather redstone and, at higher stages, glowstone.
species.antcolonies.reef.desc: A hybrid of Shore and Jungle Ants, as bright as a coral reef. Bring living coral blocks and fans of all five colors.
species.antcolonies.rubber.desc: Wood Ants fed rubber that tap rubber trees. Bring rubber logs and saplings; at a Harvesting Site they bring rubber for MachinaOpus's cables.
species.antcolonies.savanna.desc: Large, bold ants of the savanna. Strip acacia, gather grain and pick over what the herds leave: bones, feathers, hide.
species.antcolonies.sculk.desc: A hybrid of Deepslate and Soul Ants from the deep dark. Bring sculk, sensors and catalysts, and the rare echo shard.
species.antcolonies.shore.desc: Beachcombing ants that work the tideline. Bring sand, kelp and ink, then prismarine and, rarely, nautilus shells.
species.antcolonies.silver.desc: Lead Ants fed silver; they shine like mirrors. Bring silver.
species.antcolonies.snow.desc: Pale ants of the frozen north that thrive where others freeze. Gather snow and ice.
species.antcolonies.soul.desc: Fire Ants touched by soul fire. Live best in the Nether; bring soul sand, basalt and blackstone, and ghast tears.
species.antcolonies.stone.desc: Tough mountain ants that tunnel through rock. Bring stone, gravel and the odd mineral; the start of every mineral line.
species.antcolonies.sulfur.desc: Fire Ants fed sulfur that live around hot vents. Bring sulfur for MachinaOpus's acids without refining oil.
species.antcolonies.swamp.desc: Mud-coated ants of swamps and mangroves. Bring clay, mud, sugar cane and lily pads, and in time slime.
species.antcolonies.tin.desc: Copper Ants fed tin: together they make bronze. Bring tin.
species.antcolonies.trap_jaw.desc: Swamp Ants fed slime balls. Their jaws snap shut faster than anything: slimes, drowned and the odd guardian.
species.antcolonies.uranium.desc: Lead Ants fed raw uranium. They glow green in the dark; bring uranium.
species.antcolonies.warped.desc: Teal ants of the Nether's fungus forests, at home in its heat. Bring netherrack, fungi and nether wart; fed blaze powder in the Nether they become Fire Ants.
species.antcolonies.wither.desc: Soul Ants fed a Nether Star in the Nether. Ash-black and grim, they bring soul sand, coal and bones, wither roses and skulls, and very rarely a Nether Star of their own.
species.antcolonies.wood.desc: Red-chested forest builders of the taiga. Gather logs, sticks and saplings.
species.antcolonies.zinc.desc: Copper Ants fed zinc, ready for Create's brass. Bring zinc.

tooltip.antcolonies.generator: Burns furnace fuel into FE and gives it to the machines next to it, such as the Genetic Laboratory.
tooltip.antcolonies.genetic_analyzer: Right-click a Terrarium, or use with a Queen in the other hand.
tooltip.antcolonies.genetic_laboratory: Upgrades, rerolls, mutates and purges a Queen's genes. Runs on FE: put a Generator next to it.
tooltip.antcolonies.genetic_sample.use: Cross into a daughter in a Queen Chamber's sample slot.
tooltip.antcolonies.guard_ant.use: Use on a block to let it out. Right-click it to make it stay or follow; sneak-right-click to put it back. Ant food heals it.
tooltip.antcolonies.hardened_chitin: Chitin baked hard in a Blast Furnace. For tier II upgrades and the Genetic Laboratory.
tooltip.antcolonies.harvesting_site: Farmer Ants grow food here, plus mushrooms, seeds and berries.
tooltip.antcolonies.hunting_ground: Hunter species kill mobs here: the mobs' loot (from their loot tables; none spawn), and food from the catch.
tooltip.antcolonies.infernal_chitin: Hardened Chitin tempered with the Nether: for tier III upgrades and high genetics.
tooltip.antcolonies.jungle_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.mineral_ant_food: Food for mineral species; their eggs need it.
tooltip.antcolonies.nest_chamber: Brood and housing: eggs at full speed, faster larvae, room for 3,000 adults and 1,500 larvae.
tooltip.antcolonies.nuptial_pheromone: Needed to rear Queens of advanced species.
tooltip.antcolonies.pale_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.queen.name: Queen %s
tooltip.antcolonies.queen_chamber: Raises new Queens from the colony's Queen.
tooltip.antcolonies.rally_pheromone: Use on a hunter colony's Terrarium: it gives up hunters for a Guard Ant.
tooltip.antcolonies.reroll_serum: Genetic Laboratory: reroll a trait (never lower) or purge a harmful mutation.
tooltip.antcolonies.royal_jelly: Rich food (400) and the base of Queen rearing.
tooltip.antcolonies.savanna_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.shore_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.snow_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.species_upgrade.effi: Foragers eat less; signature finds more often (%s%%)
tooltip.antcolonies.species_upgrade.proc: Finds come processed (nuggets to ingots, fragments to gems), +%s%%
tooltip.antcolonies.stone_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.storage: More room for what the colony finds, and food room. Hoppers can empty it; Storage Upgrades open more slots.
tooltip.antcolonies.swamp_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.terrarium: The heart of a colony. Put a Queen in and feed her. Chambers placed against it, or against its chambers, join the colony. Take the Queen and ants out in Test Tubes before breaking it: what is left inside is lost.
tooltip.antcolonies.test_tube: Holds caught ants. Keep some in your inventory when using Tweezers.
tooltip.antcolonies.tweezers: Catches wild ants into empty Test Tubes in your inventory. Also works on wild nests.
tooltip.antcolonies.tweezers.terrarium: On a Terrarium: take workers (sneak: eggs) to start another colony.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.automation: Storage: pushes its finds into the container below.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.breeding: Faster egg laying and Queen rearing.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.genetic: Cheaper lab work; more mutations in Queen Chambers.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.hunting: Hunting Ground: stronger hunters, more catches, fewer losses.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.population: More ants housed, or more working in one chamber.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.simulation: Terrarium: more offline catch-up (numbers only, no entities).
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.speed: Faster work in chambers and the lab, faster larvae.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.storage: Storage: more slots and more food room.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade_base: The blank every upgrade starts from.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade_station: Makes species upgrades from an Upgrade Base and a species' signature material.
tooltip.antcolonies.void_chitin: Infernal Chitin steeped in the End: for the highest genetics and the Dragon Ant.
tooltip.antcolonies.warped_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.wood_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
